name: Westfield Topanga
address: 6600 Topanga Canyon Blvd, Canoga Park, CA 91303
description:
Westfield Topanga stands as the retail powerhouse of the San Fernando Valley, representing the largest shopping destination in the valley and one of the most impressive retail developments in the Western United States. Spanning an impressive 1.6 million square feet across its multi-level campus in Canoga Park, this architectural marvel features nearly 400 stores, making it a virtually one-stop destination for nearly every retail category imaginable.

The mall's prestige is underscored by its unique anchor tenants and boutique selections. Westfield Topanga is home to California's only Neiman Marcus and Target that occupy the same retail complex, alongside a flagship Nordstrom that serves as a destination retail experience. This exclusive tenant configuration, combined with luxury brands like Prada, Dolce & Gabbana, and Burberry, positions Westfield Topanga as a premium destination that attracts affluent shoppers seeking both luxury and variety. The three-level Nordstrom flagship creates an elegant retail environment that sets the tone for the entire property.

Located at the intersection of Topanga Canyon Boulevard and Warner Center Drive, Westfield Topanga benefits from premium visibility and accessibility in a high-traffic commercial corridor. The mall serves as a regional destination for shoppers throughout the San Fernando Valley, and its reputation as one of the busiest malls in the United States is well-deserved. Modern amenities including extensive dining options, entertainment venues, and seasonal events create an environment that encourages extended shopping visits.

The property opened in 1964 and has undergone continuous modernization and renovation to maintain its status as a premier retail destination. Its diverse tenant mix—balancing luxury brands with practical retailers, anchor department stores with specialty boutiques—creates a shopping experience that appeals to virtually every demographic. For valley residents and regional shoppers, Westfield Topanga has become synonymous with comprehensive, quality retail that rivals even the most prestigious shopping destinations in Los Angeles.
